description: Investigate elevated latency or error rates using operator-reported monitoring evidence; escalate unclear or persistent incidents.

facts.name: affected_scope
facts.description: Affected service, environment, incident start time and customer impact

facts.name: monitoring_status
facts.description: Operator-observed monitoring state: healthy (metrics within thresholds, no breached alerts) or degraded

facts.name: recovered
facts.description: Whether service health stayed stable and all alerts cleared during the observation window

steps.instruction: Which service and environment are affected? Provide the incident start time and customer impact. Do not include secrets.
As an authorized operator, inspect the monitoring dashboard. Report current error rate, p95 latency, observation time, and whether an alert threshold is breached. Do not restart or modify services.
Observe for the normal monitoring window and report whether service health is stable and all alerts have cleared. If not, report the remaining impact.
